scope.universe_warning: fixed surviving cash-only subset; not historical market or App candidates

preconditions: Independent review accepts the exact source, registry, dataset and corporate-action identities.
A rights-safe mechanism makes the exact normalized inputs available to the isolated runner; the current derived artifact alone is insufficient for full replay.
The signal-count reporting repair uses a new source commit and preserves run 36081668572 unchanged.
Every registered trial and failure is retained; no variant may be omitted after results are known.

work_items.description: Emit separate raw_confirmation_count, eligible_order_count and avoid_chase_count for S1/S2, while asserting identical eligible signals and fills against the frozen first run.
acceptance: all five strategies and three fixed cost/capital scenarios retained
eligible signals, fills, completed trades and portfolio metrics match the frozen run bit-for-bit except schema additions
any mismatch invalidates the repaired run and is recorded

work_items.description: Apply predeclared robustness gates to S3 without selecting a new signal rule.
work_items.decision_rule: Failure of any gate keeps S3 exploratory. Passing all gates still does not establish OOS alpha or authorize trading.

work_items.description: Evaluate exactly two new contraction thresholds while holding every other S4 rule fixed.
work_items.multiplicity_rule: Report both variants and all scenarios. Do not select or promote the best development return; these thresholds were proposed after inspecting S4 v1 diagnostics.
work_items.decision_rule: Development output may only reject or retain a hypothesis for later independent evaluation. It cannot produce a deployable winner.

work_items.description: Bound the effect of absent cash payment dates under two exact accounting paths for all five price strategies.

paths.rule: recognize receivable on ex-date; never release to spendable cash during the study
release the ex-date entitlement to cash on the next market session; label as an optimistic bound, not a factual payment schedule

work_items.decision_rule: Show both paths. Do not use the optimistic bound as the headline return or as promotion evidence.

blocked_robustness.reason: The current strategy requires at least five complete momentum members and the eligible subset has exactly five; deleting one changes the strategy into an invalid four-member panel.
blocked_robustness.unblock: Acquire a point-in-time-defined panel with at least ten eligible symbols without using 2024+ holdout data.

blocked_robustness.test: S5 revenue and S7 broker-revision factors
blocked_robustness.reason: No licensed point-in-time event history with publication, revision, correction and entitlement provenance.

global_decision_rules: Weekly 5%, monthly 10% and annualized 50% are not selection criteria.
No development-only result may be called out-of-sample, alpha, validated profitability or deployable.
Do not replace the v1 registry, ledger, zero-trade S4 result or failed trials.
Any implementation defect requires a new commit and run with an explicit invalidation reason; no silent overwrite.
Article publication, merge and deployment remain outside this proposal.
